## 📋 Task Proposal Rubric Review

**Recommendation:** 🔴 **REJECT**

<details>
<summary>Full Review</summary>

Proposal summary:
gev\-think\-rsi proposes iterative learning of a small external compute\-allocation router around frozen GEV\-26B\-Decide\. The router selects bounded reconsideration or checking actions, never answer content\. Its reference is the existing B0 confidence\-threshold policy, compared by exact free\-response accuracy on a declared 200\-item, five\-family benchmark under matched resource ceilings\. Evaluation inputs, answers, seeds and diagnostic oracles are intentionally public and included in Work\.

Evidence reviewed:
| Evidence type | Sources and findings |
| --- | --- |
| Contributor public expertise | The contributor supplied Jing Qiu and ajing@autotrust\.ai and explicitly associated the submission with aajing\. Public repository publication text corroborates that association\. The contributor\-selected AutoTrustAI release attributes commit e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca to aajing; its patch is dated September 1, 2026 and describes fixed\-budget neural language\-model optimization, reproducibility controls and author\-reported repeated experiments\. This establishes relevant experience in model optimization and controlled automated research, although it does not independently establish authorship of GEV or prior success with this particular router mechanism\. Sources reviewed October 10, 2026: \`https://github\.com/aajing\`; \`https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks\`; \`https://github\.com/AutoTrustAI/autoresearch\-sota\-strategy/commit/e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca\.patch\`\. Unrelated researchers sharing the name were not attributed to this contributor\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks\)\) |
| Six-month frontier activity | The review window is April 10–October 10, 2026\. Two distinct, directly relevant public preprints were verified: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test\-Time Compute Allocation, first submitted August 20, 2026, studies learned selection among bounded reasoning modes; When2Think: Learning When and How Much to Reason, first submitted September 17, 2026 and revised September 28, studies difficulty\-aware allocation using success and token\-cost statistics\. Both overlap the allocation question, although they modify model behavior through post\-training rather than fitting this proposal's external router around frozen weights\. Sources: \`https://arxiv\.org/abs/2608\.20256\`; \`https://arxiv\.org/abs/2609\.19671\`\. The public GEV model card supplies additional adaptive\-thinking precedent, but is a model release, not another distinct paper\. Searches did not establish usable dated X evidence; this is a coverage limitation, not evidence of inactivity\. The search establishes recent activity across separate author groups, not an exhaustive literature census\. \(\[arxiv\.org\]\(https://arxiv\.org/abs/2608\.20256\)\) |
| Repository | The supplied repository evidence contains only a fetch failure, not metadata, a pinned tree or task\-file contents\. Its HTTP 422 request incorrectly uses the Hugging Face model revision 7c89590ead085bf77630b4bf68264ea30b6ddc78 against the GitHub task repository\. The requested task implementation revision is instead 2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d\. Attempts to verify that GitHub revision did not return usable commit evidence; consequently, no independently resolved task SHA is available\. The public release dated October 10, 2026 corroborates the declared implementation SHA, handoff SHA f0a1cbe14bfcc731bcace1261b59db388ae1facf and an existing public package\-delivery interface, but does not substitute for a pinned source audit\. No contents of prepared\-tasks/gev\-think\-rsi/task\.py, policy\.py, runtime\_adapter\.py, configs/b0\.json, configs/budget\.json, data/manifest\.json, prompts/ or the declared scripts were reviewed\. Repository landing and release pages were used only for publication, identity and delivery evidence, not as replacement code evidence from another revision\. Source: \`https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/releases/tag/public\-proposals\-2026\-10\-10\`\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/releases/tag/public\-proposals\-2026\-10\-10\)\) |

Hard gate review:
| Gate | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contributor Expertise Alignment | Pass | The supplied professional identity and email, contributor\-confirmed account association, public attribution and published fixed\-budget neural\-model optimization work establish credible relevant expertise\. This finding does not rely on institutional prestige, name similarity or inferred GEV authorship\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks\)\) |
| Source Repository | Pass | An identified public task\-owned overlay, explicit upstream relationship, pinned artifact references and an existing public release interface establish a concrete source\-and\-delivery route at proposal level\. The selected local lane is one node with one GPU and does not require remote candidate execution, sidecars or privileged nested containers\. Missing dependency locks, ordinary native runtime integration and unmeasured H100 operation are implementation or validation limitations, not independently demonstrated lane incompatibilities\. Exact revision and file verification remain outstanding; the erroneous evidence fetch is not treated alone as proof that the repository or artifacts do not exist\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/releases/tag/public\-proposals\-2026\-10\-10\)\) |
| Model-Development AutoResearch Scope | Pass | Adaptive inference\-compute allocation around a frozen model is directly related to model development\. Training\-derived feedback and development selection can support repeated changes to routing objectives, calibration, stopping and action allocation; this is not merely a one\-shot implementation task\. |
| Traceable Baseline | Pass | The submitted reference is concretely identified as configs/b0\.json at the declared task revision: a short draft, frozen S1 check, confidence threshold 0\.8 and at most one 1,024\-token reconsideration\. Solution copies and validates the existing policy without fitting or evaluation; subsequent comparisons use the same controller, allowances and metric as candidates\. The two additional controls are distinguished from the reference, and upstream option\-based scores are explicitly not claimed as this benchmark's baseline\. The lack of a reproduced model score is acceptable at this stage, while the unavailable pinned file contents remain an evidence limitation\. |
| Scientific Objective and Metric | Pass | The objective is clear: improve free\-response accuracy over fixed\-threshold escalation under matched inference ceilings\. The proposed delivered workload contains 200 evaluation items across five equal families; accuracy, parsing failures, per\-item cap behavior and unscored invalid/crashed/incomplete runs are explicitly defined\. Attempts, discarded generations, controls and inherited trace costs are charged\. The explanation that confidence can misallocate reasoning and that extra reasoning can hurt is technically plausible at proposal stage\. No measured baseline, variance estimate or established headroom is required for this finding\. Dataset cardinality and verifier implementation remain unaudited because the supplied source bundle failed\. |
| Research Action Space | Pass | The proposal permits multiple meaningful threshold and bounded\-MLP hypotheses while freezing model weights, prompts, features, tools, decoding and scoring\. It specifies the admitted artifact, five compute actions, parameter bounds and prohibited answer\-producing or evaluator\-modifying behavior\. The evaluation\-exposure problem is assessed separately rather than treating these research freedoms as inherently invalid\. |
| Evaluation Integrity | Fail | Direct evaluation of finite JSON router artifacts, controller\-generated answers, candidate\-code exclusion, charged inference and unscored invalid outcomes are appropriate\. The proposal also accurately acknowledges the shared Work/Judge snapshot\. The material problem is task\-specific: complete public evaluation labels and case\-level oracles are available before artifact selection, while a feature\-conditioned MLP can encode evaluation\-specific compute choices without emitting answers or using explicit IDs\. Artifact admission, frozen manifests and answer\-file exclusion from the solver interface do not detect that form of evaluation\-conditioned optimization\. Disclosure and reclassification as exploratory evidence acknowledge the limitation but do not preserve the submitted reserved\-from\-selection comparison\. The failure is not the absence of a separate hidden final split or platform\-wide root isolation\. |
| Data and Network Boundaries | Fail | Research\-time web access and external services are separately prohibited; additional data is bounded to 2,000 locally generated training scenarios with duplicate rejection and charged provenance\. However, evaluation inputs, labels, checking worlds and executable diagnostic oracles are deliberately included in Work\. The train\-only fitting restriction and exposure disclosure do not establish how evaluation\-conditioned router fitting or selection would be prevented or detected\. Offline execution prevents external acquisition, not use of the already accessible evaluation information\. This unresolved data\-use boundary affects the claimed router\-versus\-baseline comparison\. |
| Task-Generation Readiness | Fail | Work candidate production, baseline\-only Solution materialization, complete artifact reload, direct Judge scoring and unscored failures are substantially specified\. Nevertheless, a Task Agent would still need a substantive resolution of whether and how evaluation\-informed routing and policy selection are excluded, versus accepted as part of a benchmark\-conditioned objective\. That changes the interpretation of feedback and the scientific comparison; it is not merely dependency pinning, timeout sizing, sandbox implementation or pending GPU validation\. The unresolved evaluation/data boundary therefore prevents direct task generation under the submitted contract\. |

Compute note:
Within normal reference: The declared lane is one physical node with one H100 80 GB, 16 CPU cores, 128 GB host RAM and 180 GB disk\. Work uses local model inference and CPU router fitting, with a two\-hour ceiling; Judge uses local model inference, tools and scoring, with a one\-hour ceiling\. Work and Judge are serial, so the end\-to\-end GPU peak is one, not two\. Using the submitted budgeting estimate, a cycle is 2 \+ 1 \+ 0\.25 = 3\.25 hours, allowing approximately 14\.8 cycles, or 14 complete cycles, in 48 hours before additional operational margin\. The planned 24\-hour trajectory accommodates seven such cycles\. The independent limit of 12 attempted scored calls remains in force during an extension and includes controls, invalid attempts and timeouts, reducing the available successful candidate evaluations\. This is a usable proposal\-level estimate, not a measured throughput result\. Model capacity, prefill costs, feature extraction and tool overhead remain unvalidated; exhausting 160,000 output tokens in the stated 45\-minute generation allowance would require approximately 59\.3 output tokens/second before other costs\. Those execution uncertainties are non\-blocking compute limitations\.

Quality review:
Not evaluated because one or more hard gates failed\.

Decision: Reject

</details>

## 📋 Task Proposal Rubric Review

**Recommendation:** 🔴 **REJECT**

<details>
<summary>Full Review</summary>

Proposal summary:
jev\-judge\-rsi proposes iterative optimization of prompts, bounded S1/S2 review and external calibration for a frozen JEV\-27B\-VL completion judge\. Its reference is the existing S1\-only B0 policy with identity calibration, evaluated against executable outcomes on a fully public, balanced, six\-family synthetic corpus\. The primary metric is Brier loss transformed into a 0–100 score\. CPU contracts and policy artifacts are published; real model orchestration, authentic usage accounting and runtime validation remain pending\.

Evidence reviewed:
| Evidence type | Sources and findings |
| --- | --- |
| Contributor public expertise | The proposal supplies Jing Qiu and ajing@autotrust\.ai and explicitly associates the contributor with GitHub account aajing\. Public checks accessed \`https://github\.com/aajing\` and the contributor\-selected AutoTrust release at \`https://github\.com/AutoTrustAI/autoresearch\-sota\-strategy/commit/e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca\` on October 10, 2026\. The commit attributes publication to aajing; its README describes fixed\-budget language\-model training, architecture and throughput optimization, with matched evaluation controls\. This establishes a relevant general model\-development contribution, but does not establish experience with multimodal completion judging or probability calibration\. The September 30, 2026 JEV release article at \`https://huggingface\.co/blog/autotrust/autotrustjev\-27b\-vl\-a\-decision\-model\-that\-learned\` credits an author displayed as ajing with account uremia\. No reliable public connection between that account and the submitting aajing identity was established, so that model\-specific authorship was not attributed to the contributor\. Unrelated researchers sharing the name Jing Qiu were also not attributed\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing\)\) |
| Six-month frontier activity | The review window is April 10–October 10, 2026\. Three distinct directly related papers were located: Calibrating LLM Judges: Linear Probes for Fast and Reliable Uncertainty Estimation, ACL July 2026, at \`https://aclanthology\.org/2026\.acl\-industry\.14/\`, studies Brier\-trained calibration of judge uncertainty; Benchmarking LLM Judges for Mobile Agent Evaluation, submitted August 11, 2026, at \`https://arxiv\.org/abs/2608\.11434\`, studies completion judging from mobile\-agent trajectories and screenshots; and Frozen Judges, Moving Agents: Version\-Dependent LLM\-Judge Error and the Limits of Judge\-Assisted Agent Evaluation, September 2026 preprint, at \`https://arxiv\.org/abs/2609\.34198\`, examines judge errors and the limitations of transporting calibration between agent versions\. These overlap the proposal's calibration, evidence\-review and executable\-reference questions\. The September 30 JEV announcement is a separate model\-release/community source, not an additional paper\. No usable indexed X activity was established; this is a search limitation, not evidence of inactivity\. \(\[aclanthology\.org\]\(https://aclanthology\.org/2026\.acl\-industry\.14/\)\) |
| Repository | The supplied repository evidence bundle contains no file contents or tree: it reports HTTP 422 after requesting the Hugging Face model SHA ba3f0d584994b37998f235c0a3f6f1beff32ba1e from the GitHub task repository\. That request does not test the declared task implementation commit\. The correct requested task ref is 2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d\. Independent GitHub commit\-metadata resolution remained unsuccessful; supplementary public raw\-file retrieval succeeded at that exact immutable SHA, without substituting a moving branch or the handoff commit\. Supplementary public\-source checks accessed prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/\{task\.py,policy\.py,runtime\_adapter\.py,data/manifest\.json,configs/b0\.json,configs/budget\.json,scripts/materialize\_baseline\.py,scripts/check\_package\.py,scripts/score\.py,scripts/fit\_calibrator\.py\} and portions of data/public/evaluation\.jsonl\. These were web\-retrieved sources, not files present in the supplied bundle\. The October 10 release page separately identifies the implementation SHA and handoff SHA f0a1cbe14bfcc731bcace1261b59db388ae1facf\. Upstream README\.md and serve\_decide\.py were accessed only at the declared model SHA\. No package tests, model inference or baseline reproduction were executed during this review\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/releases/tag/public\-proposals\-2026\-10\-10\)\) |

Hard gate review:
| Gate | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contributor Expertise Alignment | Fail | The required name and contributor\-provided email are present, and the supplied account association was considered\. However, the attributable public contribution establishes language\-model training and systems optimization rather than the specific multimodal completion\-judging and calibrated\-probability research question\. The more directly relevant JEV author credit belongs to a different account whose connection to this contributor could not be reliably established\. Sufficient task\-specific public expertise evidence was therefore not established; this is an evidence finding, not a claim that the contributor lacks the expertise\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/AutoTrustAI/autoresearch\-sota\-strategy/commit/e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca\)\) |
| Source Repository | Pass | The public task overlay identifies its relationship to the pinned JEV model and makes the CPU research target, policy admission, corpus provenance and scoring auditable\. Supplementary exact\-SHA retrieval recovered substantive source despite the supplied fetch error\. The upstream card documents a native local serving route on one GPU with at least 80 GB, and the proposal selects one H100 on one node without remote execution or an essential Docker\-socket dependency\. The unavailable runtime adapter is explicitly fail\-closed; implementing orchestration, dependency locks and usage collection remains task implementation, not evidence of a required nonexistent execution service\. Commit\-metadata verification remains a documented limitation\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/task\.py\)\) |
| Model-Development AutoResearch Scope | Pass | Optimizing a frozen model's judging prompts, review/recheck strategy and external probability calibration is model\-development research\. Training/development predictions and costs can guide multiple revised candidates; the proposed loop is not merely one implementation or an internal model rollout\. |
| Traceable Baseline | Pass | B0 is an existing identity\-calibrated S1\-only policy paired with the pinned released model\. scripts/materialize\_baseline\.py validates and copies that policy into judge\_policy\.json without model calls or fitting\. Baseline and candidates use the same observations, Brier metric and resource/comparison protocol\. B1 is a review/recheck control, while a fitted B2 is correctly identified as Work\-produced rather than an existing reference artifact\. Missing measured model scores do not prevent proposal\-level baseline traceability\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/configs/b0\.json\)\) |
| Scientific Objective and Metric | Pass | The objective is calibrated completion probability under fixed inference resources\. Brier loss and its scalar transformation are explicit, with malformed completed verdicts assigned item loss 1 and invalid policy artifacts, crashes, global timeout or incomplete execution unscored\. Calls, tokens, controls, retries and inherited traces are counted\. The manifest identifies materialized 480/144/240 records; construction and contract\-test source define distinct worlds, balance and split exclusions\. No additional few\-shot exclusion is specified\. Prompt decomposition, evidence review and calibration provide technically plausible improvement directions without requiring measured baseline variance at proposal stage\. Contract tests were inspected but not executed\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/data/manifest\.json\)\) |
| Research Action Space | Pass | The agent can test requirement\-decomposition prompts, S2 review, S1 recheck, training sampling and bounded affine or two\-hidden\-layer calibration\. Model weights, observations, preprocessing, features, decoding, gold and scoring remain fixed\. The final artifact and prohibited answer lookup, solver hooks, evaluation fitting and score tampering are explicit\. The published policy admission code enforces declarative fields, call\-graph constraints and finite calibration parameters\. Token\-based bounds still require implementation, as the current admission check uses a character limit\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/policy\.py\)\) |
| Evaluation Integrity | Pass | Direct evaluation of the submitted declarative policy is appropriate\. The proposal requires fresh trusted model calls, observation\-only model inputs, complete coverage, frozen scoring assets and rejection of supplied prediction/reward files as official results\. It accurately declares that all evaluation content is visible and explains the reproducibility purpose and limited claims of this open\-benchmark design\. Bounded non\-executable policies, train\-only fitting rules, artifact freezing, audited traces and invalidation of confirmed violations provide proposal\-level safeguards\. They do not prove that a prompt or calibrator was uninformed by public labels; protocol compliance and adaptive overfitting remain material limitations\. The shared Work/Judge snapshot is acknowledged, with no unsupported clean\-verifier assumption\. The diagnostic scorer expressly does not certify model provenance or official eligibility\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/policy\.py\)\) |
| Data and Network Boundaries | Pass | The proposal separately bounds research\-time web use, services and additional data: no research web access or external services; public model/dependency acquisition during construction; offline execution; and at most 960 generated training cases using supplied generators, recomputed gold and cross\-split duplicate rejection\. Evaluation labels cannot be fitting targets, development is selection\-only, and synthesis, retries and controls consume Work budgets\. Public evaluation exposure is explicitly disclosed rather than presented as secrecy\. The manifest and release identify concrete public delivery rather than a promised future asset\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/data/manifest\.json\)\) |
| Task-Generation Readiness | Pass | The proposal specifies the research question, B0 reference, direct candidate\-only evaluation, action space, public\-data exposure, offline boundaries, per\-phase resources and failure semantics\. Work produces the policy; Judge reloads the complete selected snapshot; Solution only materializes B0 without fitting, inference or evaluation\. Ordinary orchestration, tokenizer enforcement, accounting collection and packaging remain implementation work, and no unsupported isolation or execution backend is essential\. Official candidates remain subject to the stated prohibition on evaluation fitting/selection; disclosed evaluation\-informed exploration is not evidence of an untouched evaluation\. The public\-label compliance limitation is retained rather than claimed solved\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/runtime\_adapter\.py\)\) |

Compute note:
Estimate incomplete: The declared lane is one physical node with one H100 80 GB, 16 CPU cores, 128 GB host RAM and 200 GB disk\. Work model inference and Judge each use one GPU; corpus generation, contract checks and calibration arithmetic are CPU\-only\. Work and Judge are serial, so end\-to\-end peak GPU count remains one\. The proposed cycle is 2 hours Work \+ 1 hour Judge \+ 15 minutes research/handling = 3\.25 hours\. This nominally permits 14 complete cycles in 48 hours before additional operational margin, but the trajectory separately caps attempted scored evaluations at 12, including controls, invalid attempts and timeouts\. Seven planned cycles consume 22\.75 hours of the default 24\-hour trajectory\. The proposal expressly treats these durations as unvalidated allocations: complete multimodal evaluation within the Judge budget and authentic token accounting remain unestablished\. Consequently, actual complete\-loop capacity is not yet supported\. This limitation is non\-blocking; the declared hardware topology is eligible\. The published budget file agrees with the resource and accounting limits\. \(\[raw\.githubusercontent\.com\]\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks/2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d/prepared\-tasks/jev\-judge\-rsi/configs/budget\.json\)\)

## 📋 Task Proposal Rubric Review

**Recommendation:** 🔴 **REJECT**

<details>
<summary>Full Review</summary>

Proposal summary:
jev\-coldstart\-rsi proposes optimizing an inference\-time personalized image\-ranking policy around frozen JEV\-27B\-VL weights\. The agent varies history representation, visual evidence allocation, prompts and bounded numerical scoring across text/image/both modalities and short/long histories\. The declared B0 policy uses the first five available history items, or all three in short\-history cells, and ranks each candidate by one native JEV probability of a rating of at least 7/10\. Evaluation is a fully disclosed Simulacra benchmark using 100 times the equal\-weight six\-cell mean NDCG@10\. The proposal is rejected because contributor alignment, auditable pinned implementation evidence, filtered\-workload verification and evaluation safeguards are not sufficiently established—not because baseline reproduction or GPU measurements are pending\.

Evidence reviewed:
| Evidence type | Sources and findings |
| --- | --- |
| Contributor public expertise | The proposal supplies Jing Qiu, ajing@autotrust\.ai and the claimed GitHub identity aajing\. The public AutoTrustAI commit e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca identifies aajing as its author; its patch is dated September 1, 2026 and publishes model\-training and optimization materials\. This supports relevant general model\-development activity by that account, but the reviewed profile and commit do not corroborate the professional\-name linkage or establish expertise in personalized multimodal ranking\. Searches did not resolve those limitations; unrelated people named Jing Qiu were not attributed to this contributor\. Sources accessed for the October 10, 2026 review: \`https://github\.com/aajing\` and \`https://github\.com/AutoTrustAI/autoresearch\-sota\-strategy/commit/e00c83e1017916f094a2b604c01d816ec6dfa9ca\.patch\`\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing\)\) |
| Six-month frontier activity | Window: April 10 through October 10, 2026\. One clearly directly related distinct preprint was verified: Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment via Preference\-rich Sample Mining and Cohort Merging, submitted July 17, 2026\. Its preference\-rich history selection and multimodal personalized aesthetic prediction directly overlap the proposed research, although its model\-merging treatment differs from the frozen\-model action space here\. Source: \`https://arxiv\.org/abs/2607\.15752\`\. The JEV\-27B\-VL model card also documents cover\-based recommendation and October 1–3, 2026 updates, but this is a model release/demonstration, not another distinct research paper\. Source: \`https://huggingface\.co/autotrust/JEV\-27B\-VL\`\. Search breadth was limited, and no directly relevant X activity was verified\. These limitations do not establish inactivity and do not affect the decision\. \(\[arxiv\.org\]\(https://arxiv\.org/abs/2607\.15752\)\) |
| Repository | The supplied repository evidence contains only a failed\-fetch report, not metadata, a tree or file contents\. It attempted to resolve ba3f0d584994b37998f235c0a3f6f1beff32ba1e in aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks, although the proposal assigns that SHA to the Hugging Face model\. The requested task implementation ref is 2a7512d966938d4618dec533c1851f8b561c6a0d; independent attempts to retrieve that commit and its declared task tree were also unsuccessful\. Resolved task commit SHA: unavailable\. No task\-repository file contents were reviewed, including baseline/policy\.py, baseline/policy\.json, configs/source\-pins\.json, scripts/materialize\.py, src/native\_client\.py or official\_judge\.py\. The public repository landing page and release page were accessible, but did not establish the pinned implementation or release payload contents\. Public model and dataset landing pages were reviewed only as contextual evidence, not as substitutes for pinned task files\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks\)\) |

Hard gate review:
| Gate | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contributor Expertise Alignment | Fail | Full name and contributor\-provided email are present\. Public evidence confirms model\-development activity by the claimed aajing account, but the reviewed sources do not reliably corroborate its linkage to Jing Qiu or establish task\-specific expertise in frozen multimodal preference ranking\. The available evidence therefore does not support a confident alignment finding; no expertise was inferred from namesakes\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing\)\) |
| Source Repository | Fail | An open\-source task repository, exact requested implementation ref, upstream model/demo pins and a single\-node, one\-GPU lane are identified\. Public model and dataset sources exist, and no essential Docker socket, sidecar or multi\-node requirement is declared\. However, the evidence fetch used the model SHA against the task repository, and the correct task implementation could not subsequently be resolved\. No pinned runnable task code was available to establish the starting environment, local baseline or native scoring integration\. The repository landing page alone cannot establish those central artifacts\. Missing image download and unmeasured latency are not themselves the basis of this failure\. \(\[github\.com\]\(https://github\.com/aajing/autotrust\-rsi\-tasks\)\) |
| Model-Development AutoResearch Scope | Pass | The task studies inference\-time personalization with a frozen multimodal model\. An agent can alter evidence selection, history compression, image composition, prompts and bounded calibration, run matched experiments, observe ranking feedback and revise its hypothesis\. This is a genuine iterative model\-development research task rather than a one\-shot implementation assignment\. |
| Traceable Baseline | Pass | At proposal level, B0 is concretely identified by the requested implementation ref and baseline/policy\.py plus baseline/policy\.json\. Its first\-five\-history selection, native one\-call\-per\-candidate positive\-event probability and matched evaluation protocol are specified, and Solution is instructed to copy the existing policy without fitting or inference\. The proposal correctly separates unrelated MicroLens demonstration results and CPU oracle checks from an unmeasured Simulacra B0 score\. No baseline reproduction is required at this stage\. This finding accepts the declared reference design, not verification that its files were delivered; unavailable implementation evidence is recorded under Source Repository\. |
